FHS::confirmed::tak_cenactag.yaml.notes: Data-integrity fix (2026-08-19): the 2026-08-17 app Submit (commit f5c7bc65) blanket-overwrote all 21 CSV rows tagged (tak_cenactag.yaml, drug_concept) to the malformed value 'OMOP: 1398937' (stray space), corrupting 15 rows that held the distinct concept RxCUI:6876. apply_results: CSV: 6 row(s) updated to OMOP:1398937; 15 previously-corrupted row(s) restored to RxCUI:6876 (see notes)

code_fix.description: Added original_curie parameter; CSV rows are now only updated when their current CURIE matches the reviewed finding's original_curie, mirroring the existing multi-value safety check in _apply_yaml. Prevents a (yaml_file, slot) pair that spans multiple distinct pre-existing CURIEs from being blanket-overwritten. Fixed once, in the same commit series as the ARIC restoration (see ARIC_change_request_20260819_06.json).
